messages:
maria: CI alert — rerank_ndcg_test is flaky on quantized-2bit nightly build. failing in 2/10 runs with small NDCG drop (~0.6%). logs: `AssertionError: ndcg@10 diff 0.0064 > tol 0.0`

ci-bot: [jenkins/#4821] rerank-suite (quantize-nightly) failed: rerank_ndcg_test

kevin: seen it. quick glance shows scores tie-breaking varying across runs. runner sorts by float score only, non-stable across threads. could be nondet ordering from parallel map.

jia: I repro locally with --runs=10, seed not fixed in the eval harness. adding seed control made failures disappear for me. also quantization can create tiny fp differences that flip ties.

maria: nice. so two contributing issues: (1) no global seed in runner/ci harness, (2) unstable sort in the reranker when topk scores are very close. both are fixable.

kevin: propose fixes: 
1) enforce deterministic RNG by setting seeds (python, numpy, torch, random) at harness entry.
2) change rerank runner to stable sort: `sorted(items, key=lambda s: ( -s.score, s.doc_id))` so tie-break deterministic.
3) emit per-query topk JSON artifact in CI so we can diff failing runs instead of just scalar NDCG.

carla: agree. + add a metric-contract tolerance for embedding-based rerank comparisons (e.g., ndcg tol 0.005) so spurious quantize noise doesn't block rollouts. but keep alerts for regressions > tol.

maria: adding seed + stable sort seems low-risk and high-value. carla, can you own the metric-contract side? kevin/jia want to do harness/runner changes?

kevin: I'll take harness + stable sort in runner. plan: small PR to `eval/runner` with unit test that runs 50 shuffles and asserts identical topk ordering given fixed seeds. include a reproducer snippet in PR description.

jia: I'll add the CI artifact support — upload `per_query_topk.json.gz` to job artifacts and point the rerank dashboard at it. that should help root cause next time.

carla: i'll draft a short PR updating `eval/metric_contracts.yml` with a rerank ndcg tolerances section and an example of when to fail vs warn. also add a one-line note in docs about quantization noise.

maria: awesome. offenders: failing test name = `tests/integration/test_rerank_ndcg.py::test_ndcg_vs_baseline` job = jenkins/#4821. include that in PRs.

kevin: quick reproducer to put in PR description:
```python
import random, numpy as np, torch
seed = 12345
random.seed(seed)
np.random.seed(seed)
torch.manual_seed(seed)
# run mini-run of rerank harness, assert ordering stable
```

maria: small nit — ensure torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) isn't required for this; it causes perf issues on GPU. we only need consistent ordering in the CPU-side ranking stage.

kevin: ack. runner ranking runs on CPU and only needs stable tie-break. will not flip on deterministic algos.

ci-bot: [jenkins/#4822] created artifact: per_query_topk.json.gz (size 28KB)

jia: uploaded sample artifact from my local run to the PR so reviewers can inspect. format: list of {query_id, topk: [{doc_id,score}], seed} so diffs show exactly which doc moved.

carla: PR references: metric-contract change -> #3214. will add examples where quantize drop is a warning vs block.

maria: timeline? If kevin/jia push by EOD we can run one full nightly tomorrow and check. carla do you need more than a day to draft contract change?

carla: I can get a draft within 24h. will add owners for approvals.

kevin: pushing PR in 30m. unit tests included.

jia: I'll open CI job change to upload artifact on failure+success so we get consistent data to debug.

maria: thanks team. follow-up: let's add a dashboard panel that shows per-model ndcg variance over last 30 runs (stddev) so flaky tests jump out. ticket to add panel -> dashboards/#104.

kevin: noted. linking PRs in the ticket once merged.

maria: marking this resolved for now — fixes in flight. will re-run nightly after merge and report back. :thumbsup:
